data.narrative:
Together AI is a Series C-stage AI & Software company seeking valuation guidance. The target's last post-money valuation stands at $8.3B, with $1.33B+ raised to date. The applicable peer universe comprises 1 public comparable (Palantir) and 8 private peers, including Figure AI, Skild AI, and Crusoe Energy at the same stage.

Two valuation methods apply directly. Stage-progression analysis uses a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical for Series C advancement, yielding $14.1B from the current $8.3B base. Peer-median analysis examines three same-sector, same-stage comparables: Figure AI at $39.0B, Skild AI at $14.0B, and Crusoe Energy at $10.0B, producing a median of $14.0B and a range spanning $10.0B to $39.0B.

The triangulated analysis across both methods supports a valuation range of $11.9B to $16.2B, with a median of $14.1B. This range reflects moderate upside from the current $8.3B valuation. Key uncertainties include the wide dispersion within peer valuations—Figure AI trades at a 278% premium to Crusoe—and the limited sample size of three stage-matched comparables. The concentration of private capital and absence of direct public trading comparables introduces estimation risk at valuation inflection points.
